title: Bay Area Rapid Studies (BARS)
body: Rachel is now examining a small sample dataset representing the number of rides taken in a month by three BayPass users: {1, $$6$$, 17}. She wants to pick a single summary statistic $$\theta$$ to describe the data. Determine the value $$\hat{\theta}$$ that minimizes each of the following objective functions.
lesson: Loss Functions and Gradient Descent B
